name: self_evolve
label: Self Evolve
description: Create, validate, publish, and reuse append-only capability packages without modifying Promethea Core.

invocation_commands.description: Create a staged capability package with an id, version, description, commands, and optional smoke-test arguments.
invocation_commands.example: evolve_create_task(goal='add a formatter', capability_id='text_formatter', version='1.0.0', description='Format text', commands=[{'command':'format_text','description':'Format text','test_args':{'text':'hello'}}])

invocation_commands.description: Get one self-evolution task and its audit trail.
Collect bounded context from a staged capability package.
Write or replace a file only inside a capability task staging directory. Use tool.py to implement handle(command, args).
invocation_commands.example: evolve_write_file(task_id='se_xxx', path='tool.py', content='async def handle(command, args): ...')

invocation_commands.description: Validate package structure and execute declared smoke tests in the process sandbox.
Publish a validated immutable version, register it, and make its tool ids callable immediately.
